resume: The two Caf benefits linked to a baby's arrival: income conditions, 2026 amounts, payment dates and what you must report in time.
aQuoiCaSert: The Paje (prestation d'accueil du jeune enfant, early childhood benefit) includes in particular the birth grant (prime à la naissance), paid once during pregnancy, and the basic allowance (allocation de base), paid every month until the child turns 3. They help cover the costs of a baby's arrival and of raising a young child. Both are paid by the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) and are subject to income conditions.
quiEstConcerne: Parents-to-be and parents of a child under 3 whose income does not exceed the limits.
Families living in France, including Martinique, for more than 9 months of the year.
aSavoir: Birth grant: €1,093.11 net per expected child (service-public.gouv.fr, amount checked as of April 1, 2026).

For the grant, the pregnancy must be declared before the end of the 3rd month and the first prenatal exam must have taken place. It is paid before the last day of the calendar month following the 6th month of pregnancy.
2026 limits (2024 net categorical income) for 1 child: €49,054 for a two-income couple or a single parent, €37,118 for a single-income couple. Plus €8,908 per additional child.
Basic allowance: €198.16 per month at the full rate or €99.08 at the partial rate depending on income. It is paid from the month after the birth until the month before the child turns 3.

In the overseas departments, including Martinique, the basic allowance cannot be combined with family allowances (allocations familiales) or their increases for one dependent child, nor with the family supplement (complément familial) (service-public.gouv.fr).
Separated parents: the Paje is not shared between parents, even under shared residence. It is paid in full to the parent designated as the beneficiary (service-public.gouv.fr).

documents.detail: Made by the doctor or midwife at the first prenatal exam, before the end of the 3rd month. It is sent to the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance) and the Caf. Keep your copy or the acknowledgment.

documents.detail: Valid copy, requested if you are not yet a Caf beneficiary.

documents.libelle: Bank details (RIB) of the beneficiary parent
documents.detail: In your name, for the payment.
Copy. Downloadable from your impots.gouv.fr account. Your income is used to check the limits.

documents.libelle: Child's birth certificate or updated family record book (livret de famille)
documents.detail: Copy, to report the birth to the Caf. Certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr or from the town hall (mairie) of the place of birth.
Available in your Mon Compte area on caf.fr.

etapes.titre: Have the first prenatal exam before the end of the 3rd month
etapes.detail: The health professional makes the pregnancy declaration. It is what opens entitlement to the grant.

etapes.titre: Create or update your account on caf.fr
etapes.detail: If you are not yet a Caf beneficiary, apply for benefits online. Report the pregnancy if the Caf has not received it.

Pregnancy declaration properly sent, contact and bank details up to date, income declared, exact family situation (couple, single parent). An incorrectly reported situation can delay or distort the calculation.

etapes.titre: Report the birth to the Caf
etapes.detail: In your online account, under change of situation, as soon as the birth certificate has been drawn up.
The grant is paid before the last day of the calendar month following the 6th month of pregnancy. The basic allowance is paid every month from the month after the birth.
